exposure: successful anatomical closure of vesicovaginal fistula
cohort: The study involved 36 women (median age 47.5 years) who underwent successful anatomical closure of vesicovaginal fistula.
finding: Successful vesicovaginal fistula repair led to significant long-term improvements in urinary symptoms, general well-being, and quality of life, with no adverse effects on bowel function, regardless of the surgical approach, while sexual function was restored in 67.6% of participants.
